name: McFarland Clinic
directions:
There are three single-stall restrooms at McFarland Clinic.
1. On the first floor, between the radiology department and the lab, there's an accessible single-stall family restroom with a changing table.
2. Also between the lab and radiology, on the opposite side of the hall, there's a set of stairs behind a door. Go down these stairs to the basement. If you take a left after exiting the stairway, you'll be in a narrow hallway. On your right, just before the drinking fountain, there's a little nook with two doors. One is a maintenance closet and the other is a single-stall non-accessible gender neutral restroom with no changing table.
3. Follow the same directions for restroom 2, but walk past the drinking fountain. If you turn left, you'll see a large atrium on the right. Walk across the atrium. There is another gender neutral single-stall inaccessible restroom with no changing table on the wall ahead of you.
comment: Restrooms 2 and 3 are usually only used by staff, but see no problems with patients or community members using them (i have worked for the clinic for 3 years). When in the basement, make sure you look at the mirrors on the wall/ceiling before going around corners; it's very easy to accidentally run into someone and scare them if you don't.

If you enter Porter Hall from the mall/lawn area - go down the hall until you drop down the ramp in the floor. Ring the doorbell of the glass door to your left.
comment:
Only available after 5pm until approx. 11pm

I have marked this as not accessible because there are 3 stair steps once inside the lab to access the bathroom, however the bathroom is sufficiently sized and kitted for wheelchairs and disabilities, so if you are under 150lbs and don't mind, I will carry you up 3 steps no problem.

Looking into the glass door you will see 3D printers to the left. Ring the doorbell and ask whoever answers "Is the manager here?" the manager will ask you "restroom?" after you confirm no other questions will be asked. If the manager says anything else than "restroom" to you just say "nevermind." 

This is a card access only lab. Please don't touch anything in the lab space if you come. 

Porter Hall is such an old building that it even lacks Women's bathrooms on most floors. I hate to think how much of a struggle it would be to find something gender neutral or accessible in this area of campus. I hope I can open my door to you.
